name: application-top-movers-list
title: Top Movers List
description: List of gainers/losers with a symbol, name, current value, and a direction-colored percent-change indicator.
useWhen: Showing a ranked or curated list of items with a value and a period-over-period percent change (stocks, crypto, products).
Direction (up vs down) is the key thing users scan for, so it needs both an arrow and a color, not just a number.
You want a compact row format rather than a full data table for a short list.
avoidWhen: The list needs sorting, pagination, or many columns — use a data table instead.
Direction doesn't matter, only the raw magnitude — a plain stat list or leaderboard-list fits better.
You need to show trend over time, not just a single percent change — pair this with metric-sparkline-card or a chart.
responsiveBehavior: The list is a fixed max-w-sm block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints.
accessibility: Direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon and text color (emerald for gainers, red for losers), never color alone.
Values and percent changes are rendered as plain, readable text — no information is encoded purely in icon shape or color for screen reader users.
The list uses semantic role="list"/"listitem" structure via <ul>/<li> for predictable navigation.

variants.title: Top movers list
variants.description: Four tickers with symbol, name, value, and a color-coded up/down percent-change indicator.
accessibility: Gains and losses both remain legible text at 4.5:1+ contrast, not just colored decoration.

variants.title: Top movers list (Dark)
variants.description: Top movers list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Emerald and red text must meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
